Structured JSON logger middleware (NDJSON to stdout).Log all fields, with health check skipping enabled.Check whether a log field should be emitted for these options.Escape a string for safe JSON embedding without allocating a JsonNode.Check whether a path is a default or configured health check path.Append value as a fixed-point decimal (same shape as formatFloat(value, ffDecimal, decimals)) directly into line without an intermediate string allocation.Append epochSec (seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z) formatted as "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ" directly into line without constructing a DateTime. Only valid for dates on or after 1970-01-01.Emit one NDJSON line per request to stdout (or custom sink).
